A letter for you

My favorite person.

Reetika, today is about celebrating you, but I still feel like I’m the lucky one.

I still remember the first time I saw your photo on Shaadi.com. We had matched there, and you were wearing a saree. I honestly don’t know what happened in that moment, but something in me simply knew. I fell for you before we had even met, and I remember thinking, “You’re the one.” It felt almost crazy to be so sure from just a photograph, but my heart had already made its decision. And now, when I look at us, it still feels like a dream. You’re my fiancée. We’re actually going to get married. Somehow, that one photo became the beginning of us, and I still feel unbelievably lucky that the woman my heart chose that day chose me too.

I love the way you make ordinary days feel important. I also love how you can be completely ready for a nap at almost any hour, as if sleeping were a full-time creative practice. I love the comfort of knowing I get to share my thoughts, plans, ridiculous jokes, quiet moments and future with you. Somewhere between all the little conversations and all the big dreams, you became home to me.

As you turn 31, I hope this year gives you more peace, more laughter, more adventures, more confidence, and more moments that make you stop and think, “I’m exactly where I’m meant to be.” And, because this is you, plenty of shamelessly good naps too.

I don’t just love you for who you are today. I love the life we are still building, the stories we have not lived yet, and the version of us that will look back one day and smile at how far we came.

And 31 is only one birthday on a very long list I want to share with you. I don’t just want to celebrate this year. I want your 40th, your 50th, your 60th, and your 75th too. I want to be beside you through all those years, still making you smile, still teasing you about your naps, and still reminding you how beautiful you are to me. I want the whole journey, together.

Happy birthday, my love. I’m grateful for you, proud of you, and endlessly excited that I get to call you my fiancée.

Forever yours ❤️

One last thing

You are my favorite future.

If I could give you one thing for your birthday, besides an uninterrupted twelve-hour nap, it would be the ability to see yourself the way I see you: beautiful, precious, strong, wonderfully human, and impossible to replace.

To my future wife,

I choose you in the exciting moments, the messy moments, the quiet ones and everything in between. I choose your hand to hold, your laugh to chase, your dreams to protect, and your heart to keep learning. Here’s to 31, to us, to all the naps I will lose negotiations against, and to every birthday still ahead of us. I want to celebrate your 75th beside you too, still holding your hand and still choosing you.

Happy Birthday, Reetika. I love you. ❤️

Always Yours, Anklesh ♥
